questions.question: When Abishai wanted to kill the sleeping King Saul in his camp, why did David tell him not to?
When David took King Saul's spear and water jug from his camp at night, why did no one wake up?

answers.text: The LORD sent a deep sleep on them
The troops were worn out from marching
The guards were off at the far end

questions.question: After David spared King Saul's life, what did David ask the LORD to do for him in return?

answers.text: Treat David's life as precious too
Give David the throne right away
Punish Saul for the long chase
